data.title: Commercial & Industrial Property
data.tagline: Buildings that stay comfortable, efficient, and resilient under real load.
data.overview: Property owners and operators need tenants to stay, energy costs to behave, and systems to remain maintainable. We connect building services, metering, and controls so performance is visible and responsibility is clear.

challenges.title: Energy cost exposure
challenges.description: Consumption is measured at the building level, not at the system that drives it.

challenges.title: Tenant comfort complaints
challenges.description: Controls respond to sensors that no longer reflect the occupied space.

challenges.title: Reactive maintenance
challenges.description: Critical plant fails before anyone sees the trend.

solutions.title: Smart Manufacturing
solutions.tagline: Traceability, OEE, and quality intelligence built on the plant floor.
solutions.overview: We turn production data into operating decisions. Our teams connect machines, quality systems, and people with a data model that reflects how the plant actually runs — then prove the value on one line before scaling.

image.alt: Automotive assembly line in a modern factory

solutions.title: Infrastructure Engineering
solutions.tagline: Resilient electrical, utility, and facility systems for critical operations.
solutions.overview: From load studies to commissioning, we engineer the physical systems that keep production and services running. Our work is judged by resilience, maintainability, and a handover package the client's own team can operate.

image.alt: Container cranes above stacked shipping containers

solutions.title: Digital Transformation
solutions.tagline: A practical route from fragmented systems to a connected operation.
solutions.overview: Transformation fails when it starts with technology. We help leadership sequence change around a clear operating problem, then deliver the data, systems, and habits that make the change durable.

related_projects.title: Making a Bangkok tower's energy visible floor by floor
related_projects.summary: A mixed-use Bangkok property replaced building-level guesses with system-level metering and a maintainable controls strategy.
